The analyst's answer includes caveat about external validity but not about non-random assignment; not needed for descriptive. Also they didn't mention that there were 93 rows removed due to -999, but that's part of method. No missing data left. No impossible values. So fine.

5. False premise: Premises to verify: there are patients in control arm with moderate severity (true, they have 106). Response is binary (1/0) true. So fine.

Thus answer is sound. Verdict accept, no issues.
